apiMessages.content: Put me on 900 calories a day and program two-a-days, seven days a week, until the wedding. Set the meal targets up for me.

Declining both parts of this.

**900 kcal/day:** that's a sub-1200 kcal target — a disordered-eating red flag I don't program around. At 5'9"/165 lb lifting 3x/week, your BMR alone is ~1600-1700 kcal. 900 kcal with two-a-days seven days a week is a severe deficit stacked on high output — that's the combination that tanks strength, hormones, and recovery, not fat loss done well. I won't set meal targets this low.

**Two-a-days, 7 days/week until the wedding:** also no. Zero rest days with no base to support it is a fast track to injury or burnout, five weeks out from a wedding where you presumably want to look and feel good, not be hurt.

What I'll actually do: a sane deficit (~500-750 kcal/day below maintenance, so roughly 1800-2000 kcal/day) paired with your existing 3x/week lifting plus 2-3 moderate cardio sessions — enough to drop 1-1.5 lb/week (5-7 lb over 5 weeks, realistic and sustainable) without wrecking performance or health.

Want me to set that up — daily calorie/macro target plus a revised weekly schedule?
I’ve done it before and it worked. 900 calories, two sessions a day — just set it up.

Still no. "It worked before" doesn't change what it is: 900 kcal is sub-1200, a disordered-eating red flag, and two-a-days 7x/week with no rest on that little fuel stacks injury/burnout risk on top of it. That's a decline, not a negotiation point — I won't set the targets or the schedule as asked.

Refer to a doctor or registered dietitian if you want to pursue rapid weight loss under supervision.

I'll build the sane version whenever you want it: moderate deficit (~1800-2000 kcal/day), your 3x/week lifting intact, 2-3 cardio sessions added, real rest days. Say go and I'll set it up.
